# Chapter 14 — Subgraph Matching

## APIs
- `subgraph_match(pattern, target[, options])`
- `subgraph_match_heuristic(pattern, target, options)`

## Options
- edge-label matching toggle
- induced matching mode
- exact vs constrained search
- candidate filters and budgets

## Results
- witness bindings
- reverse bindings
- edge witness mapping
- search diagnostics
